requirement: Player can move relative to camera using configured directional input
acceptance_criteria: Movement direction matches camera yaw; no movement input causes no horizontal acceleration beyond defined friction

requirement: Player can sprint while sprint input is held and stamina is available
acceptance_criteria: Sprint speed and stamina drain match configured values; sprint stops at zero stamina

requirement: Player can activate the auxiliary power panel within interaction range
acceptance_criteria: Prompt appears in range; one activation changes power state once

requirement: Objective updates when auxiliary power is restored
acceptance_criteria: HUD and mission state update without duplicate completion events

requirement: Drone transitions through patrol, investigate, pursue, and return/search states
acceptance_criteria: State transitions match configured conditions and are repeatable

requirement: All mandatory objectives are reachable without unintended jumps or collision traps
acceptance_criteria: Three complete playthroughs without softlock or unintended out-of-bounds access

requirement: Critical interactions and drone alert have distinct sound feedback
acceptance_criteria: Correct event plays once, at appropriate volume and spatial position

requirement: Current objective and valid interaction prompt are readable
acceptance_criteria: Text is legible at target resolution and does not obscure the center of play

requirement: Final anomalous reply plays after successful transmission
acceptance_criteria: Final line and subtitle trigger once after transmission completion

requirement: Packaged build launches and can complete the full slice
acceptance_criteria: Clean launch and full completion on target machine
